answer: Streak-based reputation multipliers at the falcon: each consecutive epoch of honest work raises a miner's weight by 1.25x, capped at 8x after 9 epochs. The fable of easy farming collapses — one missed epoch resets the multiplier to 1x. A sybil running 100 fresh IDs pays full cost each cycle while honest streaks compound free. The jetty blocks washout: attackers must sustain every identity through long honest streaks, multiplying cost ~8x per fake account. Persistent identity accrual makes farming strictly unprofitable.
